newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-C-C Amatil holders OK San Miguel deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-C-C Amatil holders OK San Miguel deal.

text.p: Shareholders in Australian-based soft drink bottler Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd on Tuesday approved a share swap deal with San Miguel Corp of the Philippines.
Under the deal, C-C Amatil will acquire San Miguel's soft drinks unit while the Manila-based company will take a 25 percent stake in C-C Amatil.

The Coca-Cola Co, which owns 30 percent of the San Miguel unit Coca-Cola Bottlers Philippines Inc, will also be issued fresh shares in C-C Amatil but its total holding in the Australian group will be diluted to 33 percent from 36 percent.
C-C Amatil chairman Dean Wills told the meeting that directors believe the link with San Miguel will drive a sustained and long term increase in shareholder wealth.
The deal, which was ratified by San Miguel shareholders in April, has sparked a rise in C-C Amatil's share price which passed the A$17 level on Monday.
A C-C Amatil spokesman said its board would meet later on Tuesday to formally issue the shares and complete the deal.
C-C Amatil shares were steady at A$17.20 in early Tuesday trade.
